prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want a quick list of specific companies/phone numbers, or just guidance on how to find a certified tester and what to ask?  

Quick guidance (fast way to get it done)
- Contact the City of Liberty Utilities or your water supplier and ask for their list of approved/certified backflow testers or any vendor requirements. They often maintain or require a list and will tell you how test results must be submitted.  
- Search for “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester near me” on Google, Yelp, Angi or HomeAdvisor. Look for plumbers, irrigation contractors and fire protection companies that advertise backflow testing.  
- Verify the technician’s certification: ask for a current backflow/cross-connection tester certification (ASSE/ABPA or state-recognized cert). Also confirm liability insurance and business license.  
- Ask what they’ll provide: test report, tag, whether they will submit results to the utility (if required), parts warranty, and estimated repair cost if the device fails.  
- Get 2–3 quotes. Typical cost to test a residential device: about $50–$125 per device; repairs (new seal, rebuild, RPZ replacement) vary widely.

Who typically does it
- Local licensed plumbers (many offer backflow testing/repair)  
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (lawn irrigation backflow devices)  
- Fire protection companies (fire-line backflow prevention devices)  
- Larger national plumbing services (Roto-Rooter and similar) that serve the Kansas City/Liberty area

If you want, I can:
- Look up and list 4–6 local companies in the Liberty, MO area with contact info and recent reviews; or
- Draft an email/phone script you can use when calling to verify certification, pricing and reporting.

Which would you prefer?
